title: Efficient Memory Management for LLM Serving with PagedAttention
authors: W. Kwon, Z. Li, S. Zhuang, et al. (9 authors)
before: Serving systems reserved a contiguous block of memory per request for the KV cache.
problem: Requests vary in length, so most of that reserved memory sat unused while other requests queued.
breakthrough: Manage the KV cache in pages like virtual memory, so blocks are allocated on demand and shared between requests.
why: Two to four times the throughput at the same cost, and it became the default open serving engine.
next: The standard deployment path for open models, including the largest MoE models.
inherits: Paged KV cache and continuous batching in production serving.
